'''Phil''' (Japanese: '''フィル''' ''Phill'') is a member of [[Laboratory of Ecology and Natural Sciences]] (L.E.N.S.) in the [[Lental]] region in [[New Pokémon Snap]].
Inspired by Todd's Pokémon photos, Phil aims to become the world's best Pokémon photographer. His signature look is his spiky hairstyle.

==In the games==
He admires {{Todd}} and looks up to him as a mentor, although this can make him a bit feisty and impatient. He is scared of the waterfall drops in [[Mightywide River]]. He treats the [[player character]] as his rival.

Phil secretly allowed the player to use the shrinking function of the [[NEO-ONE]] without the permission of [[Professor Mirror]], though when he learned about this, Todd helped him out by talking to Professor Mirror.

He is good friends with [[Rita]], though he sometimes argues with her.

==In animation==
[[File:Rita Phil M23.png|thumb|250px|left|Phil in ''[[M23|Secrets of the Jungle]]'']]
Phil made a cameo appearance in ''[[M23|Secrets of the Jungle]]'', taking pictures in [[Milyfa Town]] with [[Rita]].

==Quotes==
'''After taking a photo'''
:''"Man! You always get the best shots!"''

'''When running a scan'''

'''When viewing the Lental Map'''

:''"How come Pokémon always look so happy in your photos?"''

'''Outside the Lab'''
:''"The other day, this {{p|Cutiefly}} was hovering right above my head, and it wouldn't buzz off even when I started running! That was a shock!"''

'''Inside the Lab'''
